living_room.caption: A regional hardwood flooring, detailed plasterwork and antique chandelier, you could be in Paris or New York. Old World Charm is still here in the sun room where Greg likes to enjoy most of his time. The first thing I see when I come in here are those timber shatters. Yes, people think that I'm signalling them with, you know, one day there'll be one open and there'll be two and I'll die a little before.

kitchen.caption: fresh featuring Italian Carrara marble bench tops and looking out the window is the old windmill Queensland's oldest building.

hallway.caption: It's beautiful, even the furniture looks a part of the home. What do you like about this space so much, this room in particular?

master_room.caption: Down the hall I have five bedrooms. It's like a large home isn't it? What do you think it was at the park? The master suite is cool and calming.
